title: Coefficients over a fixed service period
heading: Count the Reduction Over a Fixed Window and Discount It
cases: undiscounted, a start in the plan's first year sums the risk removed over its service years
every start counts the same number of years after its work ends
every year's reduction is discounted back to the plan's first year, whatever the start
a reduction t years after the plan's first year is divided by (1 + rate) to the power t
